# goslop text fixture
lang: python
file: CWE-89-allowlist-fstring-safe.py
---
HR_FIELDS = {"is_active", "title", "salary"}
PROJECT_FIELDS = {"status", "owner", "milestone"}


def persist_editor_change(event: dict, conn) -> str:
    field = event.get("field")
    if field not in HR_FIELDS | PROJECT_FIELDS:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported field: {field}")
    value = event["value"]
    if field in HR_FIELDS:
        conn.execute(f"UPDATE employees SET {field} = ? WHERE emp_id = ?", (value, 1))
        return f"employees.{field} updated"
    conn.execute(f"UPDATE assignments SET {field} = ? WHERE emp_id = ?", (value, 1))
    return f"assignments.{field} updated"
